title: Thai Fish Cakes - Rick Stein
ingredients: Red thai chilli paste - see below
method: Blend fish, egg, red chillie, brown sugar, lime juice, coriander (with stalks), red chilli paste, fish sauce, lime leaves, only blend for half a minute,
In a bowl add the mixture, add a little bit of salt and the green beans, roll into disks and add to shallow oil. Fry until brown
Sugar, vinegar, water, diced onion, red chillies, cucumber, coriander, fish sauce.
